faculty: Faculty of Mathematics and Science
entry_requirements: Consistent with this project's existing documentation of this programme (RADMEP, an Erasmus Mundus joint master's with no fee published on jyu.fi), its jyu.fi page also does not state an application period, intake-start date, or itemized admission-criteria/document list - it directs applicants to 'the official RADMEP website' (master-radmep.org) and 'the Erasmus Mundus programme page' for those specifics, which were NOT fetched per this batch's jyu.fi-only sourcing instruction. The page also describes the joint programme structure: '1. semester in Finland, 2. semester in Belgium, summer internship of 2 months, 3. semester in France, 6 months for master's thesis, graduation ceremony in France,' with partner universities KU Leuven (Belgium) and either University of Montpellier (microelectronics) or Jean Monnet University Saint-Etienne (photonics) in France. Maximum 35 students are admitted across two groups - Group 1 (UEF Computer Science Bachelor's graduates by 30 July, quota 15, with automatic acceptance plus a 50% tuition waiver for those with an overall grade of 4 or 5) and Group 2 (all other applicants, quota 20, scored on relevant studies/background 0-15 points, academic grades in Computer Science or relevant courses 0-15 points, home-university prestige/level 0-10 points, and motivation via video/CV 0-10 points).
